description: This Java source file defines a custom runtime exception class 'ThingPreconditionFailedException', which is used to indicate that a validation of a precondition header for a 'Thing' resource has failed. It provides mechanisms for creating instances via a builder pattern, parsing from JSON, and associating with HTTP headers and status codes.

classes.name: ThingPreconditionFailedException
classes.description: A final class representing a specific runtime exception thrown when a precondition header validation fails for a 'Thing' resource.

classes.name: ThingPreconditionFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of 'ThingPreconditionFailedException' with a fluent API. It is not thread-safe.

methods.name: ThingPreconditionFailedException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingPreconditionFailedException' from a JSON object containing error details.

methods.name: ThingPreconditionFailedException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a 'ThingPreconditionFailedException' with specific header information.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides the method to set Ditto headers in the exception, returning a new exception instance with updated headers.
